title: Mod manifest (mod.json)
description: One mod folder's manifest. Spec 6.1-6.2: folder name is a suggested id, the manifest id is authoritative. `provides_*` files are optional; absent means an empty list.

id.description: Globally unique namespace across the mods folder.

version.description: Semver of the content, not the schema.

api.description: Schema/contract version this content targets. A mod targeting api N > engine api is rejected.

settings.description: Named settings this mod declares, validated against deck settings values.

prompts.description: Prompt kinds this mod declares (prompt envelope vocabulary).

signals.description: Named signals this mod may emit via emit_signal.
